census.method: One GET per DISTINCT HOST listed in either public x402 Bazaar (Coinbase CDP, PayAI), using the first resource that index advertises for that host. Conformant = HTTP 402 AND a PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header AND x402Version 2 in the body AND an extensions.bazaar block. Identifiable UA, 12s timeout, 24 concurrent. Nothing signed, nothing paid, no door settled.
census.rule_note: x402_version and has_bazaar_extension are read from the BODY, as the 2026-09-05 snapshot did; header_x402_version / header_has_bazaar_extension carry the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header's own reading. header_v2_bazaar_not_body counts doors that pass in the header only.
census.not: a seller's honesty, product quality, price, or whether a door would deliver after payment. Measurement, not certification.
census.producer: scripts/census/x402-bazaar-conformance.py (councilof-ai), run by the daily census job on the estate's measuring host

payload.reading_note: census.method's 'Nothing signed' describes the probe run: nothing was paid or settled. This leaf is the board signature over that run's published summary. The two index frames (cdp, payai) overlap by host; never add them.

verify: POST this leaf to https://councilof.ai/api/verify, or read https://councilof.ai/api/x402/index
